digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge_state cache and tickets repository storage
propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB, of which 92% is the reconciler's .bridge_state cache (not actual ticket events at 55 MB), due to scattered edits across a sort-ordered 18 MB bindings.json file defeating git delta compression.

The baseline_advanced_at field changes 1144 times per reconcile pass but is read nowhere in src/, and last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping changes 20 times per pass, together causing 12.79 KB marginal cost per version.

Deleting the timestamp field baseline_advanced_at achieves 7.4x cost reduction, and moving last_get_pass bookkeeping to a separate file halves version churn for a 12.8x total improvement in marginal pack cost.
The .bridge_state cache must remain on-branch because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners and requires durable state in git, but its content and churn (not location) drive growth.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import can reduce the existing tickets branch from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4% of original) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and keeping HEAD tree byte-identical.
